paras: Are you looking to add a little more control and customization to your Varex equipped exhaust system? Look no further! We are excited to announce the release of our Drive Mode feature for our Varex Smartbox controller unit. This feature will allow you to control your Varex equipped exhaust system from the OEM Drive Mode vehicle controls, making it easier and more convenient than ever before.
If you're unsure whether this will fit your vehicle, contact our team of experts via email at hello@iilumolab.com and send through a few photos of the car for us to verify fitment.
hl: Control your VAREX equipped exhaust system from your OEM controls with the new factory drive mode feature.
Requires VAREX Smartbox. (not compatible with the standard Varex analogue key fob control unit.)
Compatible with BMW F Series and Toyota A90 Supra 4pin connector with Pulse Width Modulated (PWM) signal.
For more information, please view the installation guide .
ft: XForce BMW F Series and Supra A90 OEM Drive Mode Factory Control 4 Pin Harness
